title: Singer Joan Lunsford and dancer Baby Briscoe
summary: He praises the band's singer and the tap dancer Baby Briscoe.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: And she was a very, very fine singer, and everybody liked her every place she went.

And we had Baby Briscoe. She was a dancer, and she was a great dancer. She danced, I'm telling you, it was a very few men could out dance her. Yeah, she was a very good dancer, and I tell you, everywhere she went, everybody was crazy about her too. And in fact, she was the best woman dancer I ever seen.
What type? Tap dancer? Tap dancer, yeah.
